final_content.statement: A property $\mathcal P$ of scheme morphisms is *étale-local on the source* if $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$ exactly when all composites $X_i\to X\to Y$ have it, for any étale covering $\{X_i\to X\}$. It is *étale-local on the target* if the corresponding equivalence holds after étale base change on $Y$. For every scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ and every étale covering $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$, the morphism $f$ is étale if and only if each composite $f\circ a_i:X_i\to Y$ is étale.
hypotheses: An étale covering of the source of f.
conclusions: Étaleness of f is equivalent to étaleness of the composites.
